_atlassian_comment: Atlassian instances by name; one entry serves both the `jira` and `confluence` sources.
A source picks one with its `instance` param — omit it when only one is configured.
Choose the `method` that matches the deployment:
oauth     — Cloud. The ONLY method that works when the site enforces an IP allowlist
(an allowlist rejects API tokens outright but honors an org-approved app).
Atlassian ROTATES refresh tokens, so a grant shared with another tool
invalidates both on every run — never point this at another client's token.
api-token — Cloud. Simplest to set up, but an IP allowlist blocks it.
pat       — Data Center / Server personal access token. Put the context path in site_url.
A source names its instance with a top-level `instance:` field in config.yaml;
omit it when only one is configured.
